file_id: Rabiul Islam vs Unknown on 18 August, 2023

sentences.text: Rabiul Islam vs Unknown on 18 August, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
August 18, 2023

In The High Court At Calcutta Ad-22 Criminal Appellate
Jurisdiction Ct. 34 Sg Crr 3058 of 2022 In the matter of: Rabiul Islam ... petitioner Mr. M.
Alam Sk.
... for the petitioner.
Md. Anwar Hossain Ms. Manisha Sharma ... for the State.
Petitioner
is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Ms. Sharma, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
Her appointment may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

The revisional application was preferred at the stage when the final argument of the case was in progress as is reflected in the order dated 21.07.2022 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 3rd Fast Track Court, Malda.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 3rd Fast Track Court, Malda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Having regard to the stage at which the petitioner approached this Court and the time which elapsed in the meantime, I am of the opinion that this is not a fit case for interference by this Court at this stage.
Needless to state that the trial was continuing in respect of an offence wherein charges were framed under Sections 498A/302 of IPC.
Pending application, if any, is consequently disposed of.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

( Tirthankar Ghosh, J. )
